page.title: Class community
page.intro: Posts in your class appear straight away to your classmates and teachers. Never write a phone number, email or home address.
page.consent: A parent’s consent for public work is recorded by the madrasa. There is no parent login, and students do not send consent from here.
page.emptyClasses: You are not in a class yet. Your teacher will add you.
page.emptyThreads: No conversations yet. You can start one.
page.moduleOff: The community is switched off for now.
page.denied: Sign in with a student or teacher account to open the community.
page.whoClass: Your class and teachers can see this.
page.whoMadrasa: Everyone at the madrasa can see this.
page.question: Question
page.contactBlocked: This post seems to contain a phone number or email. Please remove it to post.
page.reportNote: Tell a teacher what is wrong
page.reported: Your report has been sent to a teacher.
page.alreadyReported: You have already reported this post.

ui.finishProfileBody: Classmates still see a generated name. Add a pen name, a pattern and a short bio when you are ready.
ui.taken: That pen name is already used.
ui.rejected: That name or bio is not allowed. Leave out real names and contact details.
ui.tooSoon: A pen name can change once every 30 days.
ui.noPhoto: A photo is not offered until file storage is set up.
ui.afterVoting: Show results after a person votes
ui.mediaGap: The file is not attached. File storage is not set up yet.
ui.submitted: Sent for review. You cannot approve your own work.
ui.verify: Turn this thread into a verified article
ui.verifyBody: Write the article in your own words
studentSteps: Welcome to the student hub. Choose Urdu or English.
This is your pen name. Classmates see this, not your real name. Teachers can see who you are.
Pick a pattern. There are no photos and no faces.
Write what you like learning. Do not write your name, phone or address.
Be kind. Never share a phone, email or address. Teachers see posts. Use Report, or speak to a teacher in person.
Class is your class and teachers. Madrasa is everyone here. Public needs a teacher’s approval.
Say salaam to your class. You can edit this, or skip.
You are ready. Open your class, the madrasa, or your account.
teacherSteps: Welcome to the teacher hub. Choose Urdu or English.
Your classes are here. You can create a student account for each child.
You can see the student behind a pen name. Hide a post or open a report.
A good thread can become a verified article, written in your own words.
